title: feat(sim): sinker body electrode - outline atom, tool record and electrode from faces
body:
fork synced at v0.20.0 · process files at PROCESS_VERSION 71 · branch from `upstream/main` 03dc12c6

## What changed

A sinker electrode can now be a BODY: a closed outline extruded along Z. Before this PR the stock sim burned a rectangular face only (the box atom of #541), and `electrode_from_faces` refused each cavity that was not an axis-aligned rectangle (`NON_RECTANGULAR`, which named this issue).

1. **Sim atom** (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/dexel_outline.rs`, `stock_sim::simulate_outline`). The outline, grown by the spark gap, is swept along straight chords through the column grid. The result is exact at each column centre: nothing is sampled. The grown section is the inside of the polygon joined with a stadium on each edge. A chord meets a stadium in one interval, in closed form. The face height is linear along the chord, so the lowest height is at the first or the last covered parameter. An arc, a posed move, a non-finite move, a bad gap and an outline that is no section are refused by name before a column is lowered. The box atom is not changed.
2. **Tool record** (`Tool::outline`, `crates/tools/src/electrode_outline.rs`). Points in mm about the burn point; empty for a rectangular face. `diameter` and `width` stay the X and Y extents of the outline, and the outline is centred on the burn point. The record's door (`is_sane`, `torch_refusal`) refuses by name an outline that is no simple section (3 to 1024 points) and sizes that do not agree with it. The key `outline` goes through the project file, the library file, the tools crate's catalog reader and the MCP `add_tool` / `edit_tool` definitions (additive, written only when stated). The operation stamp digests the points.
3. **`electrode_from_faces`** (`crates/motion/src/sinker_electrode_body.rs`). A cavity that is no axis-aligned rectangle yields a body electrode. The obstruction check uses the cavity's own outline as the column. The size law of #543 judges an outline on its extents (`Undersize::outline`).
4. **The program verdict** burns a record that has an outline with the outline atom, and a record without one with the box atom. The field eye still refuses a program with an electrode (#548).

The decisions are in `docs/decisions/1152-electrode-body.md`.

## Done means

- A rounded-corner pocket's faces yield an electrode whose burn `simulate_document` judges clean: `a_rounded_pockets_faces_yield_an_electrode_whose_burn_is_judged_clean`.
- A burn of the same electrode in a smaller cavity is convicted as a gouge: `the_same_electrode_in_a_smaller_cavity_is_convicted_as_a_gouge`.
- The non-rectangular refusal of #547 is gone: `a_cavity_that_is_no_rectangle_yields_a_body_electrode` (a rotated rectangle, an L, a chamfered corner).

## How tested

Pinning tests:

- `crates/sim/tests/stock_outline.rs` (new, 5 tests): a plunge burns the section grown by the gap and nothing else; a rectangular outline burns what the box atom burns; a sampled oracle with an independent distance rule and inside rule bounds a sloping sweep from both sides; each refusal is by name and leaves the grid untouched; garbage input burns or refuses and never raises a column.
- `crates/tools/src/electrode_outline.rs` (2 unit tests), `crates/tools/src/catalog_asset_tests.rs::a_catalog_electrode_keeps_its_outline`.
- `crates/motion/src/sinker_electrode_body_tests.rs` (new, 4 tests), `sinker_electrode_tests.rs` (`a_cavity_that_is_no_rectangle_yields_a_body_electrode`, `a_body_electrodes_column_is_the_cavitys_outline_not_its_bounds`), `sinker_undersize.rs::sinker_undersize_judges_an_outline_on_its_extents`. The existing electrode fuzz test now also derives body electrodes.
- `crates/app/tests/sinker_electrode_body.rs` (new, 5 tests): the two "Done means" tests; an L cavity; a diamond cavity; the project file round trip and the stale burn after a re-cut outline. Each clean verdict has a contrast: the rectangle of the same two sizes is convicted in the pocket's corners (rounded pocket) and in the notch (L).
- `crates/app/tests/sinker_electrode_mcp.rs::a_rounded_pocket_yields_a_body_electrode_over_mcp`, `crates/app/tests/tool_library.rs::a_body_electrodes_outline_roundtrips_through_the_library`, `crates/app/src/stock_sim_held_tests.rs::the_outline_atom_burns_a_column_grid_and_a_field_refuses_it_by_name`.

Mutation check: 51 mutations, one for each new refusal line, stamp line and dispatch line. Each mutation was applied, the pinning suite was run and was red, the file was restored and compared byte for byte with its backup. 51 of 51 red.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, 5 steps. The first run: tools, sim, motion and app suites green (21 min), the ui step red with a compile error (the tool page's draft built a `Tool` without the new field). The fix makes the draft carry the outline (`ToolUi::outline`), pinned by `crates/ui/tests/sinker_setup.rs::the_tool_draft_carries_a_body_electrodes_outline_through_an_apply`. The ui step was then run again with `--only ui` (10 suites): green. Only `crates/ui` changed between the two runs. `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`: clean. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

## What was not exercised

- A real EDM control. The conditions are synthetic and the blocks are built in code.
- An orbit or a side burn of a body electrode through an operation. The lateral sweep of the atom is pinned in the sim crate against the oracle.
- The UI pages. No page generates, shows or edits an outline (#548 owns the sinker pages). The tool page's draft carries the outline through an Apply (pinned); an edit of the X or Y size of a body electrode on the page is refused by name by the record's door.
- The batch gate, the release lanes and the pixel snapshots.
- Windows and macOS.

## Limits, each refused by name or filed

- A wall picked as its welded (curved) face: refused as before. #1808.
- A drafted wall or a stepped floor: refused as before. #1809.
- A finish pass of a cavity with sharp corners that are not square to the axes: the size law refuses it as under size. #1810.
- An outline of more than 1024 points: refused by name.
- An older build reads a body electrode as the rectangle of its two sizes (it skips the unknown key). That rectangle contains the outline, so the old build burns more, not less.

No new command, so no new MCP tool. `electrode_from_faces` answers `electrode.shape` and `electrode.outline`. The camcraft-mcp skill's table is a process file and is not touched here.

Changelog: A sinker electrode can be a body: `electrode_from_faces` makes an outline electrode for a cavity that is not an axis-aligned rectangle (a rounded-corner pocket, an L, a rotated rectangle), the tool record carries the outline through the project file, the library and MCP, and the program verdict burns it with a new outline atom.

Effort: max (not escalated)

Fixes #1152

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)


## Tool draft before / after

Authentic captures of the egui tool editor using the same synthetic L-section electrode (10 × 8 mm). Both captures edit X to 12 mm and click the editor's Apply. The rectangular preview is unchanged: it does not visualize the electrode's XY outline.

Before: reproduction of the former draft-transfer behavior, clearing the draft outline before Apply. The edit succeeds (E-L becomes Ø12); the stored tool loses its section and becomes a rectangular electrode.

![Before: former draft behavior reproduced](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/18b32fc1/1811/before.png)

After: the current draft retains the outline. Apply refuses the inconsistent X extent by name, and the stored E-L remains Ø10 with its original section. The red refusal is visible below Apply.

![After: outline preserved and inconsistent extent refused](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/18b32fc1/1811/after.png)

Images are stored only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Captured with a temporary test harness running the shipping shell and real Apply button. The harness asserted both stored outcomes and was removed after capture. The permanent behavior pin is `the_tool_draft_carries_a_body_electrodes_outline_through_an_apply`.
